description: This file is a shell script library with shared functions for CI pipelines, supporting CI systems like GitHub Actions and GitLab CI. It includes functions for grouping log output, managing build artifact skipping, and environment setup.

methods.name: begin_group
methods.description: Defines a function to start a log group, with different implementations for CI systems or a no-op if unsupported.

methods.name: end_group
methods.description: Defines a function to end a log group, with corresponding CI-system adaptations.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Wrapper function to run commands within a log group.

methods.name: skip_branch_tip_with_tag
methods.description: Skips the build if the branch is exactly at a tag, avoiding redundant builds.

methods.name: is_usable_git_repository
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a valid Git repository.

methods.name: save_good_tree
methods.description: Saves the current Git tree hash to a file to enable skipping unchanged trees.

methods.name: skip_good_tree
methods.description: Skips the build if the current Git tree matches a previously tested good tree.

methods.name: check_unignored_build_artifacts
methods.description: Checks for unignored build artifacts in the repository.

methods.name: handle_failed_tests
methods.description: Placeholder for handling failed tests; in this file, it returns a failure status.

methods.name: create_failed_test_artifacts
methods.description: Collects and archives logs of failed tests for review.

search-terms: skip build based on git trees
